drafts.title: The Ascension of Jack
drafts.reasoning: The 'I' in the source is an unnamed narrator, not a named character. This chunk involves Jack, Laura, and implicitly references the broader cast. The dramatic conflict revolves around Jack's unexpected transport to a utopian skyscraper and his interaction with Laura, highlighting themes of surrealism and the absurdity of the revolution's circumstances.
drafts.scene: A surreal desert landscape fades into view, with distant floating metropolises shimmering under a strange, synthetic sky. A hobo Jack, wearing a party cowboy hat, sits on a milk crate, scratching a lottery ticket. Synthetic wind blasts his hat off his head, which rolls away like a tumbleweed. A stealth Uber-Drone uncloaks from the sand, swallows Jack into a prone-position transit pod, and launches him vertically into the stratosphere toward the floating metropolis of NEO-BABYLON. Jack is deposited into a sleek office cubicle of a skyscraper workplace utopia. Laura, a reality-star diva, screams at management, her inbound transit-pod having been routed too close to the automated porta-potty sanitation fleet. A poster of a floating metropolis adorns the wall behind them.

dialogue.line: Jack, now seated in a sleek office cubicle of a skyscraper workplace utopia, looks bewildered as Laura, a reality-star diva, screams at management, her inbound transit-pod having been routed too close to the automated porta-potty sanitation fleet.
What the high-nass is going on here? My pod was too close to the port-o-potties!
A poster of a floating metropolis adorns the wall behind them.
And in a way to cement your fine legacy with AI? Uh, cover me buddy with your pilot... P-Pirate Radio Broadcast? Don't look at me old witch. Cover me?
